test_config_files: test that all config yaml files in configs and examples directories load correctly
collect_config_yaml_files: collect all config yaml files from the configs and examples directories recursively
validate_config_has_llm_models: validate that a loaded config contains at least one llm model
load_config_from_yaml: load a yaml config file into a Config object using load_config
run_config_validity_tests: run the unittest suite to verify all project config files are valid
